programs.title: The Curse Of Oak Island
programs.desc: Brothers Rick and Marty Lagina believe they may actually be on the cusp of making a monumental breakthrough on the island after discovering something very unusual that could finally unlock its long-held secrets once and for all.

programs.title: Gold Rush
programs.desc: The remnants of the Hoffman crew reach their lowest point, but someone brings Todd good news; Tony Beets fires his barge captain, then runs aground up the mighty Yukon River; Rick Ness finally gets Parker Schnabel's second operation up and running.

programs.title: Alaska Gold Diggers
programs.desc: The team races to find gold before the end of the season in Fairbanks. Plummeting temperatures slow their work and threaten the equipment, and it's not clear if they will mine enough gold to make it worth returning next year.

programs.title: Wheeler Dealers
programs.desc: Elvis convinces Mike to buy a bargain VW Golf convertible. But its bright colour is divisive, and it's also rusty, filthy with a busted convertible roof!

programs.title: How It's Made
programs.sub_title: Motion Sensors; Belt Loaders; Pheasant Breeding; Diving Helmets
programs.desc: Discover how combination squares and ball valves are constructed. Also, explore how shrimp are farmed and see how string trimmers are made.

programs.title: How It's Made
programs.sub_title: Rawhide Lampshades; Chocolate Chip Cookies; MRI Scanners
programs.desc: A look at how a factory takes rawhide and produces lampshades; a machine bakes chocolate chip cookies in a large over for mass production; a look at how a factory builds MRI scanners for medical professionals such as neurologists.
